title: Finite-stage source and support composition comparisons for rational purity
statement: With the geometric source maps of [def-pur-rational-purity-line-comparisons] and the published purity setting [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity], retain the rational compact-support compositor and its counit mate for exceptional composition. At algebraically closed coefficients use the literal finite stage to compare common-stage pullback with inclusion of rational pullback, and define the common source composition and base-change comparisons. The common compact-support compositor is uniquely fixed by the rational compositor and counit-normalized inclusion comparisons at every finite stage; its counit mate gives common exceptional composition. Retain the original rational and common composition clauses and all their hypotheses, including arbitrary Cartesian base change.

source.place: Steps 2 and 4, finite-coefficient presentation and coefficient compatibility of the source and support maps; existing common-stage constructors are relocated unchanged.

proof.text: Use the existing rational compact-support composition and its counit mate. The finite-stage common-support existence statement is split off as [lem-pur-rational-common-support-composition-existence]. The uniqueness wrapper is proved by isomorphism extensionality: every common-stage object is a literal pair (i,K), and both candidate isomorphisms have the prescribed component there. The remaining common pullback, source composition, base-change, and composition clauses are retained unchanged.

proof_origin.place: E9 compilation subdivision; the uniqueness wrapper is discharged by componentwise extensionality and existence is split into a strictly simpler finite-stage statement.

def commonPullInclusion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (i : Index l Ω) (K : Stage l Ω Y i) :
    (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f).obj ⟨i,K⟩ ≅
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion i).obj
        ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω i) f).obj K)
